verses.sloka: इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः ।सन्दिश्य च ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्निर्जगाम ह ।। ५.२१.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: ityuktvā maithilīṁ rājā rāvaṇaḥ śatrurāvaṇaḥ ।sandiśya ca tataḥ sarvā rākṣasīrnirjagāma ha ।। 5.21.1।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the demon's haughty words, oppressed, pitiable Sita replied slowly in a sorrowful tone.
translations.hindi: सीताजो के इन कठोरं वचनो को सुन, राक्षसराज ने सुन्दरी सीता से उत्तर में ये घ्रप्रिय वचन कहे

verses.sloka: निष्क्रान्ते राक्षसेन्द्रे तु पुनरन्तःपुरं गते ।राक्षस्यो भीमरूपास्ताः सीतां समभिदुद्रुवुः ।। ५.२१.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: niṣkrānte rākṣasendre tu punarantaḥpuraṁ gate ।rākṣasyo bhīmarūpāstāḥ sītāṁ samabhidudruvuḥ ।। 5.21.2।।।।

translations.english: Sita, austere, beautiful and chaste afflicted by grief kept sobbing. Brooding over her husband and trembling in fear, she placed a blade of grass in between her and Ravana and replied with a gentle smile on her face.
translations.hindi: हे सीते | जेसे-जेसे पुरुष स्त्री को समझाता है, वैसे ही वैसे स्त्री उस समझाने वाले पुरुष के वश में हो जाती है । किन्तु मेने प्रिय वचनों द्वारा जितना तुझे समझाया, तुने उतना ही मेरा तिरस्कार किया

verses.sloka: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः ।परं परुषया वाचा वैदेहीम् इदमब्रुवन् ।। ५.२१.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sītāmupāgamya rākṣasyaḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ ।paraṁ paruṣayā vācā vaidehīm idamabruvan ।। 5.21.3।।।।

translations.english: "Turn your mind away from me and fix it on your wives. You should not expect to seek me just as a sinner cannot hope to seek blessedness.

verses.sloka: पौलस्त्यस्य वरिष्ठस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः ।दशग्रीवस्य भार्यात्वं सीते न बहु मन्यसे ।। ५.२१.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: paulastyasya variṣṭhasya rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ ।daśagrīvasya bhāryātvaṁ sīte na bahu manyase ।। 5.21.4।।।।

translations.english: "I was born of high lineage and joined a meritorious family by virtue of my marriage. I am devoted only to my husband. I should not commit this contemptible, forbidden act."
translations.hindi: मनुष्यों के लिए काम सचमुच बड़ा बन्धन है, क्योंकि जिसके प्रति काम | उमर प्राता. है, निश्‍चय हों उसके ऊपर स्नेह प्रौर दया उत्पन्न कर देता है

verses.sloka: ततस्त्वेकजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।आमन्त्र्य क्रोधताम्राक्षी सीतां करतलोदरीम् ।। ५.२१.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastvekajaṭā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।āmantrya krodhatāmrākṣī sītāṁ karatalodarīm ।। 5.21.5।।।।

translations.english: Glorious Vaidehi having thus spoken to the demon turned her back and continued:

verses.sloka: प्रजापतीनां षण्णां तु चतुर्थो यः प्रजापतिः ।मानसो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः पुलस्त्य इति विश्रुतः ।। ५.२१.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: prajāpatīnāṁ ṣaṇṇāṁ tu caturtho yaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ pulastya iti viśrutaḥ ।। 5.21.6।।।।

translations.english: "I cannot be your lawful wife obtainable by your personal efforts. I am a chaste woman married to another man. (Being a king) examine the dharma honestly and adopt a pious way of life.
translations.hindi: हे बरानने ! यही कारण है कि, में तेरा घात नही करता । नहीं तो तू मार डालने ग्रौर तिरस्कार करने ही योग्य है । उस तपस्वी राम में तेरी प्रीति निपट झूठी है !।%॥ परुषाणीह वाक्यानि यानि यानि ब्रवीषि मास्‌ । तेषु तेषु वधो युवतस्तव मेथिलि दारुणः

verses.sloka: पुलस्त्यस्य तु तेजस्वी महर्षिर्मानसः सुतः ।नाम्ना स विश्रवा नाम प्रजापतिसमप्रभः ।। ५.२१.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: pulastyasya tu tejasvī maharṣirmānasaḥ sutaḥ ।nāmnā sa viśravā nāma prajāpatisamaprabhaḥ ।। 5.21.7।।।।

translations.english: "O nightranger Enjoy your wives. Take care of them. Taking your example, others' wives also deserve to be protected.

verses.sloka: तस्य पुत्रो विशालाक्षि रावणः शत्रुरावणः ।तस्य त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हसि ।मयोक्तं चारुसर्वाङ्गि वाक्यं किं नानुमन्यसे ।। ५.२१.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya putro viśālākṣi rāvaṇaḥ śatrurāvaṇaḥ ।tasya tvaṁ rākṣasendrasya bhāryā bhavitumarhasi ।mayoktaṁ cārusarvāṅgi vākyaṁ kiṁ nānumanyase ।। 5.21.8।।।।

translations.english: "The wives of others will insult an evilminded man who is not satisfied with his own wives, is fickleminded and has no control over his senses.
translations.hindi: मेने जो अवघि निश्चित कर दी है, उसमें दो मास श्रभी शेष हैं, तब तक तो मुझे तेरी रक्षा करनी ही उचित है । अधिक बीतने पर तुझे मेरी सेज पर झाना ही पड़ेगा

verses.sloka: ततो हरिजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।विवृत्य नयने कोपान्मार्जारसदृशेक्षणा ।। ५.२१.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato harijaṭā nāma rākṣasī vākyamabravīt ।vivṛtya nayane kopānmārjārasadṛśekṣaṇā ।। 5.21.9।।।।

translations.english: "Are there no pious men around or are you not heeding their words? Your mind is perverted and inclined to commit a forbidden act.

verses.sloka: येन देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवराजश्च निर्जितः ।तस्य त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हसि ।। ५.२१.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: yena devāstrayastriṁśaddevarājaśca nirjitaḥ ।tasya tvaṁ rākṣasendrasya bhāryā bhavitumarhasi ।। 5.21.10।।।।

translations.english: "You are indulging in unrighteous act and not listening to the advice of wise men who have a sense of discrimination. You are the cause of the destruction of demons.
translations.hindi: रावण द्वारा. सीता को इस प्रकार धमबाई जाती देख, वे सब देव और गन्ध कन्याएँ, जो रावण के साथ श्राई थी, साता को कनखियों से देख-देख, बहुत दुःखी हुई

verses.sloka: वीर्योत्सिक्तस्य शूरस्य सङ्ग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनः ।बलिनो वीर्ययुक्तस्या भार्यात्वं किं न लप्स्यसे ।। ५.२१.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: vīryotsiktasya śūrasya saṅgrāmeṣvanivartinaḥ ।balino vīryayuktasyā bhāryātvaṁ kiṁ na lapsyase ।। 5.21.11।।।।

translations.english: "Even prosperous countries and cities are destroyed on account of indiscreet rulers engaged in unfair means.

verses.sloka: प्रियां बहुमतां भार्यां त्यक्त्वा राजा महाबलः ।सर्वासां च महाभागां त्वामुपैष्यति रावणः ।। ५.२१.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: priyāṁ bahumatāṁ bhāryāṁ tyaktvā rājā mahābalaḥ ।sarvāsāṁ ca mahābhāgāṁ tvāmupaiṣyati rāvaṇaḥ ।। 5.21.12।।।।

translations.english: "Having got you as its ruler, this Lanka filled with gems (riches) will perish without delay for the crime of one individual.
translations.hindi: उनसे भ्राइवासिता सीता, भपने पात्व्रित्बल से बल।न्वित हो, श्रपने हित की बात रावण से कहने लगी

verses.sloka: समृद्धं स्त्रीसहस्रेण नानारत्नोपशोभितम् ।अन्तःपुरं समुत्सृज्य त्वामुपैष्यति रावणः ।। ५.२१.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: samṛddhaṁ strīsahasreṇa nānāratnopaśobhitam ।antaḥpuraṁ samutsṛjya tvāmupaiṣyati rāvaṇaḥ ।। 5.21.13।।।।

translations.english: "O Ravana living beings will welcome and enjoy the destruction of a shortsighted sinner killed by his own vile act.
translations.hindi: हे रावण ! मुझे विश्‍वास हो गया कि, इस लकापुरी मे तेरा हितैषी कोई नहीं है, जो तुझे इस गहित कमं करने से रोके

verses.sloka: असकृद्देवता युद्धे नागगन्धर्वदानवाः ।निर्जिताः समरे येन स ते पार्श्वमुपागतः ।। ५.२१.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: asakṛddevatā yuddhe nāgagandharvadānavāḥ ।nirjitāḥ samare yena sa te pārśvamupāgataḥ ।। 5.21.14।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing you, getting ruined this way for your sin, those who were angry with you for their humiliation in your hands will feel glad and say 'Luckily this terrible fellow has met with his doom' .
translations.hindi: क्योंकि तीनों लोकों में तेरे सिवाय दूसरा कोई भी ऐसा पुष न होगा, जो इन्द्र की पत्नी शची की तरह धर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की पत्नी मुझको चाहने की मन में कल्पना भी कर सके

verses.sloka: तस्य सर्वसमृद्धस्या रावणस्य महात्मनः ।किमर्थं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्यात्वं नेच्छसेऽधमे ।। ५.२१.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya sarvasamṛddhasyā rāvaṇasya mahātmanaḥ ।kimarthaṁ rākṣasendrasya bhāryātvaṁ necchase'dhame ।। 5.21.15।।।।

translations.english: "I cannot be lured by your power or wealth. I am inseparable from Raghava like light from the Sun.

verses.sloka: यस्य सूर्यो न तपति भीतो यस्य च मारुतः ।न वाति स्मायतापाङ्गे किं त्वं तस्य न तिष्ठसि ।। ५.२१.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: yasya sūryo na tapati bhīto yasya ca mārutaḥ ।na vāti smāyatāpāṅge kiṁ tvaṁ tasya na tiṣṭhasi ।। 5.21.16।।।।

translations.english: "How can I pillow on somebody's arm after resting on the honourable arm of the great lord of the worlds ?
translations.hindi: यद्यपि दपित हाथी और खरगोश वन में एक साथ ही रहते हें तथापि जेसे वे बराबर नहीं हो सकते बैसे ही श्री राम चन्द्रजो हाथी के समान हूँ और तू क्षुद्र खरगोश की तरह "है

verses.sloka: पुष्पवृष्टिं च तरवो मुमुचुर्यस्य वै भयात् ।शैलाश्च सुभ्रु पानीयं जलदाश् च यदेच्छति ।। ५.२१.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: puṣpavṛṣṭiṁ ca taravo mumucuryasya vai bhayāt ।śailāśca subhru pānīyaṁ jaladāś ca yadecchati ।। 5.21.17।।।।

translations.english: "I am alone the lawful wife of the lord of the earth like the knowledge of the Vedas which rightfully belongs to a wise brahmin who has realised the self after having had his ceremonial bath (as a token of celibacy) and having observed strict vows during the period of his study.

verses.sloka: तस्य नैरृतराजस्य राजराजस्य भामिनि ।किं त्वं न कुरुषे बुद्धिं भार्यार्थे रावणस्य हि ।। ५.२१.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya nairṛtarājasya rājarājasya bhāmini ।kiṁ tvaṁ na kuruṣe buddhiṁ bhāryārthe rāvaṇasya hi ।। 5.21.18।।।।

translations.english: "O Ravana it is proper for you to unite me in distress with Rama as one would unite a female elephant with the lordly elephant from which it is separated in the wilderness.
translations.hindi: ्रे तेरी ये क्रूर प्रौर टेढ़ी-मेढ़ी काली-पीली ग्रा, जिनसे तूने मुझे बुरी निगाह से देखा है, निकल कर पृथिवी पर क्यों नहीं गिर पड़तीं

verses.sloka: साधु ते तत्त्वतो देवि कथितं साधु भामिनि ।गृहाण सुस्मिते वाक्यमन्यथा न भविष्यसि ।। ५.२१.१९।।
verses.transliteration: sādhu te tattvato devi kathitaṁ sādhu bhāmini ।gṛhāṇa susmite vākyamanyathā na bhaviṣyasi ।। 5.21.19।।

translations.english: "I wish you to build friendship with Rama, the bull among men. Surely it is the right thing for you to do, if you are desirous of avoiding a dreadful death.
